svg.title: DeskBuddy AI wiring diagram
svg.desc: An ESP32-C3 board connects to an INMP441 microphone board and a MAX98357A amplifier board over shared I2S clock lines, to a 1.3 inch OLED display and a humidity sensor board over I2C, to two push buttons on GPIO 4 and 5, and to 5 volts through an on/off switch. The amplifier drives a speaker.
svg.text: ESP32-C3 with I²S audio, I²C display, two buttons and a switched 5V supply
